title: Connect your server to goon.vc
description: Walks a server admin through what goon.vc should do for their Discord server. The answers are recorded per server for alliance leadership.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Let's connect **{{context.guildName}}** to goon.vc. It takes a couple of minutes: I'll record your answers, and alliance leadership finishes the hookup.

features.say: What should goon.vc do for **{{context.guildName}}**? Pick everything you want.

calendar.say: Your scheduled events show on the goon.vc calendar. Should they also go on the alliance-wide PERMAFLEET schedule?

clips.say: Which channel do your members post clips in? goon.vc collects the videos and Medal links posted there into the clip library.

announcements.say: Which channel should IdleRPG post in? It welcomes new players and announces level-ups, battles, and finds there. Chatting in that channel costs players XP, so pick a quiet one.

org.say: Which org is joining PERMAFLEET? Give its name or RSI symbol. Every pilot joins the [PERMAFLEET] org on RSI before undocking; the tag is how our operators know you're ours.

stewards.say: Who are your Org Stewards, the officers who speak for your org? They get the Org Steward role and a direct line to alliance leadership. Give their Discord names.

permissions.say:
goon.vc's bot needs **View Channels**, **Send Messages**, and **Read Message History** in the channels you picked. Missing on **{{context.guildName}}** right now: {{context.botMissing|nothing, you're set}}.
Add the bot, or update its permissions: {{context.inviteUrl}}

complete.say: Saved. Alliance leadership will finish connecting **{{context.guildName}}**; ask in #embassy on the G00N SQUAD Discord if anything comes up. Run `/goon setup` again any time to change your answers.

cancelled.say: Setup cancelled, and nothing was saved. Run `/goon setup` in your server to start again.
